title: Great, what to do 🇪🇸🚲👍
text:
We had a great time with Mathias. Explanation of the history of Seville and its culture always with joy and humor. We highly recommend.
We hope to return to discover more walks with centerbici. Thanks to you.
author: Nicolas B

title: We saw beautiful areas...
text: We saw beautiful areas and sights. Much easier then walking that far. The bike trails are very nice and the tour guide was informed and fun .
author: John_P

title:
Seville has a special color!!
I decided to teach my Swiss friends to know Seville in a different way
text:
See almost all seville on bicycles a great pleasure. Highly recommended
I am from Seville living in Switzerland for 10 years this year I have been able to travel and enjoy with Swiss friends.
author: Sarasuiza

title: Great experience!
text: We had a very good experience when we took the Sevillan Tour. Matias, our guide, was truly amazing; friendly, serviceminded and had vast knowledge about Seville. The stories he told gave us a new look at Seville and we have a much better understanding now than when we arrived. A warm recommendation from us! Ask for Matias to be your guide he knows it all!
author: martvet8

title: Bilingual Tour from Seville to Bicycle
text:
Excellent visit with my 14 year old daughter , a friend and Celine our guide.
She speaks French and enchanted us with her knowledge of Seville.
A very nice time spent with him.
Note that Centerbici bikes are impeccable.
Thanks again.
author: francoisetournez

title: Bike tour of Seville
text:
Really enjoyed the tour. Got to know a lot of interesting facts about the past and present of Seville. Our 8 year old son had fun too and asked a lot of questions.
Would definitely recommend.
author: Natalya K

title: The Sunday city spinn
text: It’s all flat ground.  You dont wear helmets.   Your guide will be fun but not necessarily super knowledgeable re the detailed history.   And the bikes are pretty ragged but work!
author: Amy_R

title: Seville Se'velo!
text:
It is very nice to visit the cent of Sevilla by bike, the city lends itself well.
We did it in March, the weather was perfect, I think we should avoid going in the middle of summer.
author: Andres L
